ana: FYI hitting a weird combo: our rerank sampleapp crashes when mixing Node and Python embed runners. Node returns 1536-d vectors, Python 1024-d. rerank helper assumes fixed dim 1024 and throws on reshape. also saw duplicated vectors when token refresh happens mid-batch. anyone seen this pattern?

kai: what model id + env flags? sounds like quantized variant selection differs between runtimes.

ana: config uses MODEL=open-embed-1024 but NODE_EMBED_Q=1 in the container. Node SDK picked open-embed-1536-q4 at runtime, python stuck to open-embed-1024. small repro: logical batch of 2 inputs split into two HTTP calls by sampleapp. first call gets 401, auth refresh, SDK retries whole logical batch -> both original and retry land, so rerank sees 4 vectors with mixed dims. logs: [2026-04-03T11:10:12Z] POST /v1/embeds batch=b-77 401 -> refresh -> RETRY 200 model=open-embed-1536-q4 ; python callback 200 model=open-embed-1024

tom: two issues: 1) node quant selector parity bug, 2) idempotency/retry behavior for batch endpoints. do we attach stable idempotency per logical batch?

ana: sampleapp splits batches at app-layer and currently generates no stable idempotency key across splits. node SDK includes Idempotency-Key per HTTP call but it's ephemeral.

kai: short-term fixes: a) add defensive dedupe in rerank helper keyed by input id/hash before reshape, b) assert and fail fast if declared vector_dim/model differ across responses, c) sampleapp: generate deterministic idempotency per logical batch and propagate to splits. long-term: SDK should include explicit vector_dim and model_id in response envelope.

tom: I'll open two PRs: rerank dedupe+assert, sampleapp idempotency glue. kai, can you file the SDK parity issue for node quant path? tag it embed-parity-quant.

devex-bot: reminder: add unit test that simulates 401 mid-batch and verifies retry is idempotent.

ana: noted. will follow up with PR links in this thread. :thumbsup:
